assets.prompt: Create a production background plate for an art-directed animated short about price anchoring. Use case illustration-story. Portrait 2:3 composition, full bleed, exquisite original Art Nouveau lithograph / gouache illustration with fine ink variable-width contours, dusty sage and pale celadon, burnt coral, antique ivory, ochre brass, deep petrol shadows. An intimate vintage clothing boutique, EMPTY OF PEOPLE. Tall magnificent arched stained-glass window at center with amber sun disc and coral/teal floral glass, curving wrought iron, side wall ornamental botanical wallpaper, elegantly crafted wooden floor with perspective. On left a deep green curtain and oval mirror, on right an elegant empty brass clothes rail, foreground two lush hand-drawn iris and poppy plants framing corners, a small antique display table right foreground. Pool of afternoon light on warm floor. Distinct near foreground silhouettes, middle floor area, distant window. Leave central/lower middle floor unobstructed for a separately animated person and coat to be composited. Entire environment must feel like a finished art print, detailed linework, pigment variation, authentic printed paper grain integrated in forms, graceful non-geometric natural shapes. No text, no numbers, no logos, no people, no mannequins, no prices, no clothing hanging in center. No photorealism, no 3D render, no flat UI. This is a scenic layer, not a poster with title space. Composition fills the whole image.

Create a single full-body isolated original female shopper for use as a moving cutout in an Art Nouveau lithograph / gouache animated boutique film. Truly TRANSPARENT background. Use case illustration-story. Adult woman age about 30, elegant and thoughtful, chin-length wavy deep brown bob, understated ivory headband, almond dark eyes, graceful long neck, warm medium skin, refined human proportions about 7 heads tall (NOT chibi), full body from hair to shoes with generous clear padding around silhouette. Wearing a flowing terracotta/rust long sleeve dress with fitted waist and decorative ochre floral hem, dark petrol blue short cape, cream stockings and brown low heels. Her left arm extends toward the RIGHT side of image at waist height with open gently curved hand, as if considering an item in a shop; right hand near body holds a small dark green handbag. Face in three-quarter profile looking right, mildly curious. Both legs in a natural standing pose, no walking stride. Beautiful line economy, variable-width deep brown ink contours, hand-drawn fabric folds, two or three gouache tone planes, warm dusty ivory/sage/coral/gold palette, fine lithograph texture contained INSIDE the silhouette. A real art illustration, not generic vector clipart, not 3D, not anime. Entire character visible, no cropping, no oval backdrop, no halo, no floor/shadow, no text, no price tags, no surrounding objects. Vertical character asset on transparent canvas.
